data.one_liner: A Flutter popup menu widget with custom content and configuration support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable popup menu widget written completely in Dart. It supports custom items with images or icons, custom content containers, and positioning via a rect or widget key.
use_when: You need a custom popup menu with icons and images
You want to display custom content inside a popup menu
avoid_when: You prefer standard Flutter Material PopupMenuButton
You need complex built-in animations that are not yet provided
strengths: Easy configuration for background, lines, and highlight colors
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of README examples
Show/hide animation support was only recently added in 0.0.6
data.minimal_example:
PopupMenu menu = PopupMenu(
      context: context,
      config: const MenuConfig(
        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
        lineColor: Colors.greenAccent,
        highlightColor: Colors.lightGreenAccent,
      ),
      items: [
        PopUpMenuItem(title: 'Copy', image: Image.asset('assets/copy.png')),
        PopUpMenuItem(title: 'Home', image: Icon(Icons.home, color: Colors.white)),
      ],
      onClickMenu: onClickMenu,
      onShow: onShow,
      onDismiss: onDismiss);
menu.show(rect: rect);
